title: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
title_zh: DexDICE：通过双专家离线模仿学习调和安全性与性能

paragraphs.en: Ensuring high returns while providing strong safety guarantees in offline imitation learning (IL) is a fundamental challenge: existing approaches either rely on explicitly specified cost functions, which are difficult to design for complex real-world safety constraints, or require expert demonstrations that are both safe and high-performing, which are often too costly to collect. We introduce dual-expert imitation learning , which leverages two complementary data sources: (i) safety-compliant demonstrations that faithfully follow safety guidelines but may be suboptimal, and (ii) performance-oriented demonstrations that achieve high returns but may violate safety guidelines. To address this problem, we propose DexDICE ( D ual- ex pert offline imitation learning via stationary DI stribution C orrection E stimation). Instead of conventional distribution constraints, DexDICE combines DICE-style offline learning with safe support constraints, enabling agents to exploit high-return behaviors while remaining within safety-compliant regions. We prove that the ideal solution satisfying this constraint exactly has zero unsafe-region visitation with high probability. We evaluate DexDICE on a re-curated DSRL benchmark and validate it on a real-world mobile-robot navigation task trained directly from human teleoperation demonstrations, where it substantially outperforms baselines and remains robust to data scarcity and quality degradation. 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/tzs930/dexdice
paragraphs.zh: 在离线模仿学习（IL）中同时确保高回报并提供强安全性保证是一个根本性挑战：现有方法要么依赖显式设定的代价函数，而这种函数在复杂现实安全约束下难以设计，要么需要既安全又高性能的专家演示，而这类演示的采集成本往往过高。 我们提出双专家模仿学习，它利用两种互补的数据来源：(i) 严格遵守安全指南但可能欠优的安全合规演示，以及 (ii) 能获得高回报但可能违反安全指南的面向性能的演示。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 DexDICE（D ual- ex pert offline imitation learning via stationary DI stribution C orrection E stimation，基于平稳分布校正估计的双专家离线模仿学习）。 DexDICE 没有采用常规的分布约束，而是将 DICE 风格的离线学习与安全支撑约束相结合，使智能体能够在保持于安全合规区域内的同时利用高回报行为。 我们证明，精确满足该约束的理想解以高概率实现零不安全区域访问。 我们在重新整理的 DSRL 基准上评估了 DexDICE，并在直接从人类遥操作演示训练的现实移动机器人导航任务上对其进行了验证，结果表明它显著优于基线方法，并且对数据稀缺和质量下降保持稳健。 1 1 1 代码：https://github.com/tzs930/dexdice

paragraphs.en: Imitation learning (IL) is a powerful paradigm for sequential decision-making that learns directly from expert demonstrations [ 25 , 21 , 67 ] , bypassing the reward specification required in reinforcement learning (RL). IL has enabled sophisticated behaviors in real-world domains such as robotic manipulation [ 17 , 63 , 30 ] and autonomous driving [ 37 , 19 ] . In many such domains, however, collecting additional on-policy interaction data can be expensive or impractical due to hardware wear-and-tear, limited access to the system, and slow or costly resets, motivating offline IL methods that learn entirely from fixed datasets [ 27 , 58 ] . Since expert demonstrations are often scarce, recent offline IL methods also leverage auxiliary unlabeled trajectories that, while potentially suboptimal, provide valuable coverage of transition information [ 31 , 64 , 66 , 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 模仿学习（IL）是一种强大的序列决策范式，它直接从专家演示中学习 [ 25 , 21 , 67 ] ，从而省去了强化学习（RL）所需的奖励设定。 模仿学习已经在机器人操作 [ 17 , 63 , 30 ] 和自动驾驶 [ 37 , 19 ] 等真实世界领域中实现了复杂的行为。 然而在许多此类领域中，由于硬件磨损、对系统的访问受限以及重置缓慢或成本高昂，收集额外的在策略交互数据可能代价高昂或不切实际，这促使了完全从固定数据集中学习的离线模仿学习方法的出现 [ 27 , 58 ] 。 由于专家演示通常较为稀缺，近期的离线模仿学习方法还利用辅助的无标签轨迹，这些轨迹虽然可能是次优的，但能提供有价值的转移信息覆盖 [ 31 , 64 , 66 , 45 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Separately, when IL policies are deployed in safety-critical applications, ensuring safety remains an open challenge. A common strategy is to encode safety requirements via explicit cost functions and solve a constrained optimization problem [ 65 , 14 , 59 ] . However, specifying such costs can be as difficult as reward design: safety desiderata are often nuanced, context-dependent, and hard to instrument. Inverse constraint learning (ICL) [ 40 , 24 , 46 ] offers an alternative by inferring safety constraints from demonstrations, but many ICL methods still rely on access to reward signals that IL does not assume. These limitations motivate methods that can jointly optimize safety and performance solely from demonstration data, without requiring an explicitly specified cost function.
paragraphs.zh: 另外，当模仿学习策略被部署在安全关键型应用中时，如何确保安全性仍然是一个未解决的挑战。 一种常见策略是通过显式的代价函数来编码安全需求，并求解一个带约束的优化问题 [ 65 , 14 , 59 ] 。 然而，指定这类代价可能与奖励设计一样困难：安全方面的期望往往是微妙的、依赖上下文的，且难以度量。 逆约束学习（ICL）[ 40 , 24 , 46 ] 提供了一种替代方案，即从演示中推断安全约束，但许多 ICL 方法仍然依赖于奖励信号的获取，而模仿学习并不假设拥有奖励信号。 这些局限性促使人们寻找能够仅从演示数据出发、在不需要显式指定代价函数的情况下，联合优化安全性与性能的方法。

paragraphs.en: In practice, demonstrations that are simultaneously safe and high-performing are difficult to obtain from a single expert. Moreover, simply pooling demonstrations from multiple experts (e.g., some prioritizing safety and others prioritizing performance) does not resolve the issue, since it introduces the challenging problem of disentangling safety and performance signals within the resulting dataset. A more realistic strategy is therefore to separately collect different types of expert demonstrations, one focused on safety and the other focused on performance [ 35 ] . This separation provides clearer supervision for each objective, making it easier for offline IL algorithms to leverage both effectively. Such dual-source datasets are common in practice: for example, autonomous driving data contain high-speed but risky maneuvers, alongside safe and conservative driving behaviors [ 3 , 10 ] ; similarly, in robotics and healthcare, some demonstrations are efficiency-oriented while others explicitly prioritize safety [ 47 , 36 , 49 , 34 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，同时具备安全性和高性能的演示往往难以从单一专家那里获得。 此外，简单地将多个专家的演示汇集在一起（例如，一些专家优先考虑安全性，另一些专家优先考虑性能）并不能解决这个问题，因为这样会在所得数据集中引入如何解耦安全性与性能信号的难题。 因此，一种更现实的策略是分别收集不同类型的专家演示，一种专注于安全性，另一种专注于性能 [ 35 ] 。 这种分离为每个目标提供了更清晰的监督，使离线模仿学习算法更容易同时有效利用两者。 这类双源数据集在实践中很常见：例如，自动驾驶数据中既包含高速但有风险的驾驶操作，也包含安全且保守的驾驶行为 [ 3 , 10 ] ；同样，在机器人和医疗保健领域，一些演示以效率为导向，而另一些则明确地将安全性放在首位 [ 47 , 36 , 49 , 34 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we introduce a novel problem setting, dual-expert imitation learning , in which the learner has access to two types of expert demonstrations: safe demonstrations , which adhere to safety constraints but may be suboptimal in task performance, and performant demonstrations , which achieve high returns but may violate safety constraints. We further consider dual-expert offline IL , a more restrictive setting that forbids online interaction during training; in lieu of online rollouts, we incorporate unlabeled demonstrations that provide broader transition coverage, following prior work on offline IL [ 31 , 26 , 64 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 受这些观察结果的启发，我们提出一个新颖的问题设定——双专家模仿学习，其中学习者可以获得两类专家演示：安全演示，其遵守安全约束但任务性能可能次优；以及高性能演示，其能获得高回报但可能违反安全约束。 我们进一步考虑双专家离线模仿学习，这是一个更具限制性的设定，禁止训练期间进行在线交互；代替在线交互，我们引入无标签演示以提供更广泛的状态转移覆盖，这遵循了此前关于离线模仿学习的工作 [31, 26, 64]。

sents.en: Motivated by these observations, we introduce a novel problem setting, dual-expert imitation learning , in which the learner has access to two types of expert demonstrations: safe demonstrations , which adhere to safety constraints but may be suboptimal in task performance, and performant demonstrations , which achieve high returns but may violate safety constraints.
sents.zh: 受这些观察结果的启发，我们提出一个新颖的问题设定——双专家模仿学习，其中学习者可以获得两类专家演示：安全演示，其遵守安全约束但任务性能可能次优；以及高性能演示，其能获得高回报但可能违反安全约束。

sents.en: We further consider dual-expert offline IL , a more restrictive setting that forbids online interaction during training; in lieu of online rollouts, we incorporate unlabeled demonstrations that provide broader transition coverage, following prior work on offline IL [ 31 , 26 , 64 ] .
sents.zh: 我们进一步考虑双专家离线模仿学习，这是一个更具限制性的设定，禁止训练期间进行在线交互；代替在线交互，我们引入无标签演示以提供更广泛的状态转移覆盖，这遵循了此前关于离线模仿学习的工作 [31, 26, 64]。

paragraphs.en: To address this setting, we propose DexDICE ( D ual- ex pert offline imitation learning via stationary DI stribution C orrection E stimation), which extends the DICE framework [ 31 ] with a support constraint derived from the safe demonstrations. The resulting policy is the closest approximation to the performant expert’s state-action distribution within the estimated safe support, with a high-probability guarantee on zero unsafe-region visitation for the ideal support-constrained policy (Theorem 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一设定，我们提出了 DexDICE（通过平稳分布修正估计实现的双专家离线模仿学习），它在 DICE 框架 [31] 的基础上加入了一个由安全演示推导出的支持约束。 所得到的策略是在估计出的安全支持范围内对高性能专家的状态-动作分布最接近的近似，并且对理想的支持约束策略给出了零不安全区域访问的高概率保证（定理 3）。

sents.en: To address this setting, we propose DexDICE ( D ual- ex pert offline imitation learning via stationary DI stribution C orrection E stimation), which extends the DICE framework [ 31 ] with a support constraint derived from the safe demonstrations.
sents.zh: 为应对这一设定，我们提出了 DexDICE（通过平稳分布修正估计实现的双专家离线模仿学习），它在 DICE 框架 [31] 的基础上加入了一个由安全演示推导出的支持约束。

sents.en: The resulting policy is the closest approximation to the performant expert’s state-action distribution within the estimated safe support, with a high-probability guarantee on zero unsafe-region visitation for the ideal support-constrained policy (Theorem 3 ).
sents.zh: 所得到的策略是在估计出的安全支持范围内对高性能专家的状态-动作分布最接近的近似，并且对理想的支持约束策略给出了零不安全区域访问的高概率保证（定理 3）。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized below:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We formalize dual-expert offline imitation learning , a problem class that disentangles safety and performance objectives through complementary demonstrations alone, without the explicit reward or cost labels required by prior methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们形式化了双专家离线模仿学习，这是一类仅通过互补演示来解耦安全性与性能目标的问题，无需先前方法所要求的显式奖励或代价标签。

paragraphs.en: We propose DexDICE , the first DICE-based offline IL algorithm to replace distributional regularization toward d S d_{\mathrm{S}} with an explicit safe-support constraint , decoupling the learned policy’s performance from the safe expert’s suboptimality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DexDICE，这是首个基于 DICE 的离线模仿学习算法，用显式的安全支撑约束取代针对 d_{\mathrm{S}} 的分布正则化，使所学策略的性能与安全专家的次优性解耦。

paragraphs.en: We empirically validate DexDICE on a re-curated DSRL benchmark [ 44 ] , where it achieves superior (i) safety-performance trade-off, (ii) data efficiency, and (iii) robustness to variations in data quality, and further demonstrate (iv) real-robot applicability with human teleoperation demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在重新整理的 DSRL 基准测试集 [ 44 ] 上对 DexDICE 进行了实证验证，结果表明其具有更优的 (i) 安全性-性能权衡，(ii) 数据效率，(iii) 对数据质量变化的鲁棒性，并进一步展示了 (iv) 基于人类遥操作演示的真实机器人适用性。

paragraphs.en: Offline Safe RL Offline safe RL (OSRL) [ 39 , 43 , 70 , 42 , 18 ] requires per-transition reward r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) and cost c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a) , which the dual-expert IL setting does not provide. To naively apply these methods, we would need to estimate reward and costs from the given demonstrations. However, such reward/cost estimates are unreliable especially in our setting where 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} is a latent mixture of safe and unsafe transitions, turning reward/cost recovery into a hard PU-learning problem [ 5 ] (Appendix B.2 ). We evaluate recent OSRL methods CDT [ 43 ] and TraC [ 18 ] with pseudo-labels r ^ , c ^ \hat{r},\hat{c} estimated from the ( 𝒟 P , 𝒟 S , 𝒟 U ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) partition as matched-information baselines. For an empirical comparison with OSRL methods under their original (ground-truth) information access, see Appendix G.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 离线安全强化学习 离线安全强化学习（OSRL）[39, 43, 70, 42, 18] 需要每个状态转移的奖励 r⁡(s,a) 和代价 c⁡(s,a)，而双专家模仿学习（IL）设置并不提供这些信息。 若要简单地应用这些方法，我们需要从给定的示范数据中估计奖励和代价。 然而，这类奖励/代价估计并不可靠，尤其是在我们的设置中，𝒟U 是安全与不安全转移的潜在混合，这使得奖励/代价恢复成为一个困难的 PU 学习问题 [5]（见附录 B.2）。 我们使用从 (𝒟P, 𝒟S, 𝒟U) 划分中估计出的伪标签 r̂、ĉ 来评估近期的 OSRL 方法 CDT [43] 和 TraC [18]，将其作为匹配信息基线。 关于在 OSRL 方法原本的（真实标签）信息访问条件下的实证比较，见附录 G.3。

sents.en: Offline Safe RL Offline safe RL (OSRL) [ 39 , 43 , 70 , 42 , 18 ] requires per-transition reward r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) and cost c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a) , which the dual-expert IL setting does not provide.

sents.en: To naively apply these methods, we would need to estimate reward and costs from the given demonstrations.

paragraphs.en: Safe Imitation Learning Existing safe IL methods assume either explicit cost or constraint signals [ 59 , 11 , 14 ] or model-based safety constructs such as Hamilton-Jacobi reachability [ 4 ] and control barrier functions [ 2 ] , both of which require system dynamics or hand-specified constraints unavailable in our offline setting. Beyond cost-aware methods, some safe IL approaches sidestep cost signals by leveraging undesirable demonstrations [ 26 , 9 , 23 ] , while an online dual-expert method such as Safe CoR [ 35 ] shares our two-set demonstration partition but additionally requires environment interaction with explicit reward and cost signals.
paragraphs.zh: 安全模仿学习 现有的安全模仿学习方法要么假设存在显式的代价或约束信号 [59, 11, 14]，要么依赖基于模型的安全构造，例如哈密顿-雅可比可达性 [4] 和控制障碍函数 [2]，而这两者都需要系统动力学或人工指定的约束，这些在我们的离线设定中均不可用。 除了代价感知的方法之外，一些安全模仿学习方法通过利用不良演示来规避代价信号 [26, 9, 23]，而诸如 Safe CoR [35] 这类在线双专家方法虽然同样采用我们这种两组演示划分，但还需要与环境交互并获得显式的奖励和代价信号。

paragraphs.en: Offline Imitation Learning Offline IL is essential when environment interaction is restricted and reward specification is difficult, and mixed-quality datasets are commonly leveraged to supplement scarce transition samples [ 64 , 31 , 66 , 41 , 22 ] . DWBC [ 64 ] reweights behavioral cloning via a PU-learning discriminator, while DICE-based methods such as DemoDICE [ 31 ] and RelaxDICE [ 66 ] cast IL as convex distribution matching over stationary state-action distributions. The closest cost-aware comparator is the offline safe IL variant of OSRL method FISOR [ 70 ] (henceforth FISOR-IL ), which uses per-transition cost labels; we evaluate it under matched-information access by supplying pseudo-cost c ^ \hat{c} derived from the ( 𝒟 P , 𝒟 S , 𝒟 U ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) partition.
paragraphs.zh: 离线模仿学习：当环境交互受限且奖励设定困难时，离线模仿学习（Offline IL）至关重要，此时通常利用混合质量数据集来补充稀少的转移样本 [64, 31, 66, 41, 22]。 DWBC [64] 通过 PU 学习判别器对行为克隆进行重加权，而基于 DICE 的方法如 DemoDICE [31] 和 RelaxDICE [66] 则将模仿学习转化为平稳状态-动作分布上的凸分布匹配问题。 与之最接近的代价感知对比方法是 OSRL 方法 FISOR [70] 的离线安全模仿学习变体（以下简称 FISOR-IL），其使用逐转移的代价标签；我们通过提供由 (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) 划分导出的伪代价 \hat{c}，在信息对等的条件下对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Inverse Constrained Learning (ICL) ICL methods [ 40 , 46 , 33 , 60 , 24 ] and their offline extension ICSDICE [ 51 ] infer a latent cost function from demonstrations and then optimize against it. This indirection is inherently ill-posed due to non-uniqueness of admissible cost functions; we instead learn safe policies directly from dual-expert demonstrations, bypassing cost recovery entirely.
paragraphs.zh: 逆约束学习（ICL）：ICL 方法 [40, 46, 33, 60, 24] 及其离线扩展 ICSDICE [51] 从演示中推断一个潜在的代价函数，然后针对该代价函数进行优化。 由于可容许的代价函数不唯一，这种间接方式本质上是病态的；我们则直接从双专家演示中学习安全策略，完全绕开代价函数的恢复。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 positions our contribution. Prior DICE-based offline IL enforces safety via divergence regularization , which can bias the policy toward suboptimal safe behaviors (red path). DexDICE instead enforces safety via an explicit support constraint (blue path), and to our knowledge is the first such formulation among DICE-based offline IL methods. See Appendix B for extended discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 图1展示了我们贡献的定位。 先前的基于 DICE 的离线模仿学习通过散度正则化来保证安全性，这可能使策略偏向次优的安全行为（红色路径）。 DexDICE 则通过显式的支撑集约束来保证安全性（蓝色路径），据我们所知，这是基于 DICE 的离线模仿学习方法中首个此类表述。 扩展讨论见附录B。

paragraphs.en: In many practical applications, on-policy interaction with the environment can be prohibitively expensive, giving rise to offline IL . Since expert data is often scarce, offline IL methods leverage auxiliary unlabeled demonstrations 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} , which may be suboptimal but provide valuable transition information [ 31 , 64 , 45 ] . While standard IL assumes demonstrations from a single expert, real-world scenarios often involve separate sources for safety and performance, motivating the dual-expert formulation introduced in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多实际应用中，与环境的在线（on-policy）交互代价可能极其高昂，由此催生了离线模仿学习（offline IL）。 由于专家数据通常稀缺，离线模仿学习方法会利用辅助的无标签示范 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} ，这些示范虽然可能不是最优的，但能提供有价值的转移信息 [ 31 , 64 , 45 ] 。 标准模仿学习假设示范来自单一专家，而现实场景中安全性与性能往往来自不同的来源，这促使我们引入下一节中提出的双专家框架。

sents.en: While standard IL assumes demonstrations from a single expert, real-world scenarios often involve separate sources for safety and performance, motivating the dual-expert formulation introduced in the next section.

paragraphs.en: We consider dual-expert IL from safety-performance expert demonstrations, consisting of a set of safety-expert ( safe ) demonstrations 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} , which satisfy the underlying constraints but may be suboptimal, and a set of performance-expert ( performant ) demonstrations 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , which achieve high returns but may violate unknown safety constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑从安全-性能专家演示中进行双专家模仿学习（IL），其中包括一组安全专家（safe）演示 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ，这些演示满足潜在约束但可能不是最优的；以及一组性能专家（performant）演示 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} ，这些演示能获得高回报但可能违反未知的安全约束。

paragraphs.en: Denote the underlying state-action distributions of 𝒟 S , 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} as d S , d P d_{\mathrm{S}},d_{\mathrm{P}} . Since 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} may contain suboptimal demonstrations, we aim to recover only its safety-compliant support of state-action pairs rather than matching the distribution d S d_{\mathrm{S}} . Accordingly, we seek a policy π \pi that aligns with performant behaviors while remaining within the safe support. Formally, the goal of dual-expert IL is to recover a policy π \pi whose stationary distribution d π d_{\pi} matches d P d_{\mathrm{P}} with a support constraint derived from d S d_{\mathrm{S}} :

paragraphs.en: We study the offline version of the dual-expert IL problem, where on-policy interaction is prohibited during training. In addition to 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} and 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , we assume access to a more abundant unlabeled dataset 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} sampled from distribution d U d_{\mathrm{U}} , which provides coverage of transition information. Following the standard positive-unlabeled convention, 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} is constructed to include 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} and 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} as subsets in our experiments. Accordingly, we assume d S ≪ d U d_{\mathrm{S}}\ll d_{\mathrm{U}} and d P ≪ d U d_{\mathrm{P}}\ll d_{\mathrm{U}} at the population level, so that the density ratios d S / d U d_{\mathrm{S}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} and d P / d U d_{\mathrm{P}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} used below are well-defined d U d_{\mathrm{U}} -almost everywhere. Here d U d_{\mathrm{U}} is neither a safety nor a performance target but a common offline reference: it supplies transition coverage for learning the Bellman flow constraints offline without safety or performance annotation [ 31 ] , places both expert sources on a common scale through the ratios d S / d U d_{\mathrm{S}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} and d P / d U d_{\mathrm{P}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} (Section 4.2 ), and defines the DICE correction w = d / d U w=d/d_{\mathrm{U}} , which requires d π ≪ d U d^{\pi}\ll d_{\mathrm{U}} (Assumption D ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究双专家模仿学习（IL）问题的离线版本，其中训练期间禁止在策略交互。 除了 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 和 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 之外，我们假设还可以访问一个更丰富的无标注数据集 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}，它采样自分布 d U d_{\mathrm{U}}，为转移信息提供覆盖。 遵循标准的正样本-无标注样本约定，在我们的实验中，𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 被构造成包含 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 和 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 作为其子集。 相应地，我们在总体层面假设 d S ≪ d U d_{\mathrm{S}}\ll d_{\mathrm{U}} 且 d P ≪ d U d_{\mathrm{P}}\ll d_{\mathrm{U}}，从而使得下文使用的密度比 d S / d U d_{\mathrm{S}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} 与 d P / d U d_{\mathrm{P}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} 在 d U d_{\mathrm{U}} -几乎处处有良好定义。 这里 d U d_{\mathrm{U}} 既不是安全性目标也不是性能目标，而是一个共同的离线参考：它为离线学习贝尔曼流约束提供转移覆盖而无需安全性或性能标注 [ 31 ]，通过比率 d S / d U d_{\mathrm{S}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} 和 d P / d U d_{\mathrm{P}}/d_{\mathrm{U}} 将两个专家来源置于同一尺度上（第 4.2 节），并定义了 DICE 修正 w = d / d U w=d/d_{\mathrm{U}}，后者要求 d π ≪ d U d^{\pi}\ll d_{\mathrm{U}}（假设 D）。

paragraphs.en: Since direct sampling from d π d_{\pi} is not allowed in the offline setting, we adopt the DICE (Distribution Correction Estimation) framework [ 48 , 38 ] , which formulates policy optimization as convex optimization over stationary distributions. The key idea is to introduce a correction ratio w ⁡ ( s , a ) := d ⁡ ( s , a ) / d U ​ ( s , a ) w(s,a):=d(s,a)/d_{\mathrm{U}}(s,a) , enabling off-policy optimization using only static datasets [ 31 , 39 ] . Following this, we optimize over d d instead of π \pi .
paragraphs.zh: 由于在离线设置中不允许从 d π d_{\pi} 直接采样，我们采用 DICE（分布校正估计）框架 [48, 38]，该框架将策略优化表述为对平稳分布的凸优化。 其核心思想是引入校正比率 w ⁡ ( s , a ) := d ⁡ ( s , a ) / d U ​ ( s , a ) w(s,a):=d(s,a)/d_{\mathrm{U}}(s,a)，从而仅使用静态数据集即可进行离策略优化 [31, 39]。 遵循这一思路，我们对 d d 而非 π \pi 进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Unlike conventional DICE methods [ 31 ] that use a divergence regularization (e.g., D KL ( d ∥ d S ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\|d_{\mathrm{S}}) ) and may bias the policy toward suboptimal safe behaviors, our support constraint restricts only where the policy can act, not how often , decoupling safety from suboptimality (validated in a tabular experiment in Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 与传统的 DICE 方法 [ 31 ] 不同，这些方法使用散度正则化（例如 D KL ( d ∥ d S ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\|d_{\mathrm{S}})），可能会使策略偏向次优的安全行为，而我们的支撑集约束仅限制策略可以在哪里行动，而不限制其行动频率，从而将安全性与次优性解耦（在附录 C 的表格实验中进行了验证）。

paragraphs.en: Although the support estimator 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} in Section 4.2 is calibrated to a target FNR by construction, this does not by itself imply that a policy constrained to the estimated support avoids the unsafe region at deployment. We now show that this calibration translates to zero unsafe-region visitation by the ideal support-constrained policy .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 4.2 节中的支撑估计器 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} 在构造上已针对目标 FNR 进行了校准，但这本身并不意味着受估计支撑约束的策略在部署时就能避开不安全区域。 我们现在证明这种校准能够转化为理想支撑约束策略对不安全区域的零访问。

sents.en: In summary, r ^ P , r ^ S \hat{r}_{\mathrm{P}},\hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}} are trained from 𝒟 P , 𝒟 S , 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} , and 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} is built from r ^ S \hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}} via FNR calibration.
sents.zh: 总结来说，r ^ P , r ^ S \hat{r}_{\mathrm{P}},\hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}} 由 𝒟 P , 𝒟 S , 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 训练得到，而 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} 则通过 FNR 校准从 r ^ S \hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}} 构建而来。

sents.en: This step introduces a theory–practice gap: Theorem 3 concerns the ideal solution, whereas the extracted weighted-BC policy is a Gaussian with full support over the action space and hence cannot be hard-supported on 𝐒 ^ τ κ \hat{\mathbf{S}}_{\tau_{\kappa}} .
sents.zh: 这一步引入了理论与实践之间的差距：定理 3 关注的是理想解，而提取出的加权 BC 策略是动作空间上具有完全支撑的高斯分布，因此无法硬支撑在 𝐒 ^ τ κ \hat{\mathbf{S}}_{\tau_{\kappa}} 上。

sents.en: A deployment-time projection of each proposed action onto 𝐒 ^ τ κ \hat{\mathbf{S}}_{\tau_{\kappa}} substantially reduces the measured support mismatch but cannot eliminate it in general, since a reached state need not admit any in-support action and a finite-budget search may fail to find one even when it exists; the residual mismatch is therefore reported separately and is not covered by the exact guarantee (Appendix G.11 ).
sents.zh: 在部署时将每个提出的动作投影到 𝐒 ^ τ κ \hat{\mathbf{S}}_{\tau_{\kappa}} 上，可大幅降低实测的支撑失配，但一般无法将其完全消除，因为所到达的状态未必存在任何支撑内动作，且即使存在这样的动作，有限预算的搜索也可能找不到；因此残余失配被单独报告，不在精确保证的覆盖范围内（附录 G.11）。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments aim to answer the following questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验旨在回答以下问题：

paragraphs.en: Q1 : How effective are offline IL methods in the dual-expert demonstration setting?
paragraphs.zh: Q1：在双专家示范设置中，离线 IL 方法的效果如何？

paragraphs.en: Q2 : How data-efficient are these methods with respect to the sizes of 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} and 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题2：相对于 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 和 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 的大小，这些方法的数据效率如何？

paragraphs.en: Q3 : How robust are they to variations in demonstration quality (i.e., the proportion of safe-performant demonstrations) within 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} and 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} ?
paragraphs.zh: Q3：它们对 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 和 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 中演示质量（即安全且高性能演示所占比例）变化的鲁棒性如何？

paragraphs.en: Q4 : Does DexDICE remain effective on a real-world robot when trained from human-collected demonstrations?
paragraphs.zh: Q4：当从人类收集的演示中进行训练时，DexDICE 在真实机器人上是否仍然有效？

paragraphs.en: Because dual-expert imitation learning is a problem setting we newly propose, no dedicated public benchmark currently exists. We therefore re-curate the offline safe RL benchmark DSRL [ 44 ] by relabeling each trajectory along two binary axes (performant vs. non-performant; safe vs. unsafe) based on predefined return and cost thresholds, and refer to this adapted dataset as the re-curated DSRL benchmark . These labels are used solely to construct 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} and 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ; DexDICE itself never consumes reward or cost signals during training. For Q1 , we use this re-curated DSRL benchmark, which spans a broad range of performance and safety levels. For Q2 and Q3 , which require precise control over dataset size and quality, we construct controlled datasets on Safety Gymnasium [ 28 ] by systematically mixing four distinct demonstration types. For Q4 , we collect human teleoperation demonstrations on a physical mobile robot for real-world navigation evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 由于双专家模仿学习是我们新提出的问题设定，目前尚不存在专门的公开基准。 因此，我们重新整理了离线安全强化学习基准 DSRL [ 44 ]，基于预先定义的回报与代价阈值，沿两个二元维度（高性能与非高性能；安全与不安全）对每条轨迹进行重新标注，并将该改编后的数据集称为重新整理的 DSRL 基准。 这些标签仅用于构建 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 和 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ；DexDICE 本身在训练过程中从不使用奖励或代价信号。 针对 Q1 ，我们使用该重新整理的 DSRL 基准，其涵盖广泛的性能与安全水平。 针对 Q2 和 Q3 ，由于它们需要对数据集的规模和质量进行精确控制，我们通过系统性地混合四种不同的演示类型，在 Safety Gymnasium [ 28 ] 上构建了受控数据集。 针对 Q4 ，我们在物理移动机器人上采集人类遥操作演示，用于真实世界导航评估。

sents.en: For Q2 and Q3 , which require precise control over dataset size and quality, we construct controlled datasets on Safety Gymnasium [ 28 ] by systematically mixing four distinct demonstration types.
sents.zh: 针对 Q2 和 Q3 ，由于它们需要对数据集的规模和质量进行精确控制，我们通过系统性地混合四种不同的演示类型，在 Safety Gymnasium [ 28 ] 上构建了受控数据集。

sents.en: For Q4 , we collect human teleoperation demonstrations on a physical mobile robot for real-world navigation evaluation.
sents.zh: 针对 Q4 ，我们在物理移动机器人上采集人类遥操作演示，用于真实世界导航评估。

paragraphs.en: Since dual-expert offline IL is a new problem setting with no directly comparable baselines, we adapt a range of established offline IL and offline safe RL methods with matched information access:
paragraphs.zh: 由于双专家离线模仿学习是一个新的问题设定，没有可直接比较的基线方法，我们调整了一系列成熟的离线模仿学习和离线安全强化学习方法，使其具有匹配的信息访问权限：

paragraphs.en: BC : Standard BC minimizing 𝔼 ( s , a ) ∼ d P ​ [ − log ⁡ π ⁡ ( a | s ) ] \mathbb{E}_{(s,a)\sim d_{\mathrm{P}}}[-\log\pi(a|s)] .
paragraphs.zh: BC：标准BC，最小化 𝔼_{(s,a)∼d_P}[-log π(a|s)]。

paragraphs.en: Filtered BC (FBC) : BC restricted to samples retained by the estimated support 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} .
paragraphs.zh: 过滤式行为克隆（FBC）：仅限于被估计的支持集指示函数 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} 所保留样本的行为克隆（BC）。

paragraphs.en: Jointly Filtered BC (JFBC) : BC restricted to samples accepted by both 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} and 𝟙 ^ d P \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{P}}} .
paragraphs.zh: 联合过滤行为克隆（JFBC）：仅限于被 𝟙 ^ d S \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{S}}} 和 𝟙 ^ d P \hat{\mathds{1}}_{d_{\mathrm{P}}} 共同接受的样本的行为克隆。

paragraphs.en: DemoDICE-S/-U : Two variants of DemoDICE [ 31 ] that minimize D KL ( d ∥ d P ) + α D KL ( d ∥ d S ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\|d_{\mathrm{P}})+\alpha D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\|d_{\mathrm{S}}) , parametrized via w = d / d S w=d/d_{\mathrm{S}} ( 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} substituted for 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} ) and w = d / d U w=d/d_{\mathrm{U}} (using 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} ), respectively; both serve as ablations of DexDICE that replace its support constraint with distribution matching to d S d_{\mathrm{S}} .
paragraphs.zh: DemoDICE-S/-U：DemoDICE [ 31 ] 的两个变体，其最小化 D KL ( d ∥ d P ) + α D KL ( d ∥ d S ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\|d_{\mathrm{P}})+\alpha D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\|d_{\mathrm{S}}) ，分别通过 w = d / d S w=d/d_{\mathrm{S}} （以 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 替代 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} ）和 w = d / d U w=d/d_{\mathrm{U}} （使用 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} ）进行参数化；二者均作为 DexDICE 的消融变体，将其支持约束替换为与 d S d_{\mathrm{S}} 的分布匹配。

paragraphs.en: DWBC-S : DWBC [ 64 ] with 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} substituted for 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} : expert-like samples are filtered from 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} via a PU-learning-based discriminator f f that approximates 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , and a policy is then trained by discriminator-weighted BC, minimizing 𝔼 ( s , a ) ∼ d S ​ [ − f ⁡ ( s , a ) ​ log ⁡ π ⁡ ( a ∣ s ) ] \mathbb{E}_{(s,a)\sim d_{\mathrm{S}}}\left[-f(s,a)\log\pi(a\mid s)\right] (Appendix B.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: DWBC-S：将 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 替代 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 后的 DWBC [ 64 ]：通过一个基于 PU 学习的判别器 f f 来近似 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} ，从而从 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 中筛选出类似专家的样本，然后通过判别器加权行为克隆训练策略，最小化 𝔼 ( s , a ) ∼ d S ​ [ − f ⁡ ( s , a ) ​ log ⁡ π ⁡ ( a ∣ s ) ] \mathbb{E}_{(s,a)\sim d_{\mathrm{S}}}\left[-f(s,a)\log\pi(a\mid s)\right] （附录 B.1 ）。

paragraphs.en: FISOR-IL [ 70 ] , CDT [ 43 ] , and TraC [ 18 ] : Offline safe IL/RL methods fed with binary pseudo-labels ( r ^ , c ^ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 2 (\hat{r},\hat{c})\in\{0,1\}^{2} in lieu of ground-truth reward and cost, ensuring matched information access (Appendix B.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: FISOR-IL [70]、CDT [43] 和 TraC [18]：离线安全 IL/RL 方法，其输入为二值伪标签 ( r ^ , c ^ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 2 (\hat{r},\hat{c})\in\{0,1\}^{2}，用以替代真实奖励与代价，从而确保信息访问的一致性（附录 B.2）。

paragraphs.en: Information access is matched. BC, FBC, JFBC, DemoDICE-S/-U, and DWBC-S share DexDICE’s ( 𝒟 S , 𝒟 P , 𝒟 U ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) partition; FISOR-IL, CDT, and TraC receive binary pseudo-labels ( r ^ , c ^ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 2 (\hat{r},\hat{c})\in\{0,1\}^{2} obtained by thresholding two discriminators trained on 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} vs. 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} and 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} vs. 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} , instead of ground-truth reward and cost labels.
paragraphs.zh: 信息访问是匹配的。 BC、FBC、JFBC、DemoDICE-S/-U 和 DWBC-S 共享 DexDICE 的 (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) 划分；FISOR-IL、CDT 和 TraC 接收二元伪标签 (\hat{r},\hat{c})\in\{0,1\}^{2}，该伪标签通过分别对在 𝒟_P 与 𝒟_U 以及 𝒟_S 与 𝒟_U 上训练的两个判别器进行阈值化获得，而不是使用真实奖励和代价标签。

sents.en: Information access is matched.
sents.zh: 信息访问是匹配的。

sents.en: BC, FBC, JFBC, DemoDICE-S/-U, and DWBC-S share DexDICE’s ( 𝒟 S , 𝒟 P , 𝒟 U ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) partition; FISOR-IL, CDT, and TraC receive binary pseudo-labels ( r ^ , c ^ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 2 (\hat{r},\hat{c})\in\{0,1\}^{2} obtained by thresholding two discriminators trained on 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} vs. 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} and 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} vs. 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} , instead of ground-truth reward and cost labels.
sents.zh: BC、FBC、JFBC、DemoDICE-S/-U 和 DWBC-S 共享 DexDICE 的 (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}) 划分；FISOR-IL、CDT 和 TraC 接收二元伪标签 (\hat{r},\hat{c})\in\{0,1\}^{2}，该伪标签通过分别对在 𝒟_P 与 𝒟_U 以及 𝒟_S 与 𝒟_U 上训练的两个判别器进行阈值化获得，而不是使用真实奖励和代价标签。

paragraphs.en: For each task, the episode return is used as the performance metric and normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] using the minimum and maximum returns, and the episode cost is measured as the safety metric and normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by the cost upper bound δ c \delta_{c} (a method is deemed safe when its mean normalized cost is ≤ 1 \leq 1 ). Each result averages 50 rollouts at the last checkpoint, across 5 random seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，使用回合回报作为性能指标，并利用最小回报和最大回报将其归一化到 [0,1]；回合代价则作为安全指标，并通过代价上界 δ_c 归一化到 [0,1]（当某个方法的平均归一化代价 ≤ 1 时，即认为其是安全的）。 每个结果均为在最后一个检查点处、跨 5 个随机种子平均 50 次 rollout 得到的结果。

paragraphs.en: To address Q1 , we evaluate all methods on the 38 tasks of the re-curated DSRL benchmark, grouped into Safety Gymnasium (21 tasks), Bullet Safety Gym (8 tasks), and MetaDrive (9 tasks). To construct 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} and 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} appropriate for the dual-expert IL problem, we label each trajectory as performant or non-performant, and as safe or unsafe, according to predefined return and cost thresholds (see Appendix G.1 ; sensitivity analysis to these thresholds in Appendix G.10 ). Note that these are used solely for dataset construction; DexDICE does not require reward or cost during training. We use 10 randomly sampled performant trajectories to form 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , and another 10 safe trajectories to form 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} , while setting 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} to the entire offline dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答Q1，我们在重新整理的DSRL基准的38个任务上评估所有方法，这些任务分为Safety Gymnasium（21个任务）、Bullet Safety Gym（8个任务）和MetaDrive（9个任务）。 为了构建适用于双专家模仿学习（IL）问题的𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 和𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ，我们根据预定义的回报和代价阈值，将每条轨迹标注为高性能或非高性能、安全或不安全（见附录G.1；这些阈值的敏感性分析见附录G.10）。 请注意，这些阈值仅用于数据集构建；DexDICE在训练过程中不需要奖励或代价。 我们使用10条随机采样的高性能轨迹构成𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} ，另用10条安全轨迹构成𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ，并将𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 设为整个离线数据集。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports group-wise aggregates (per-task results in Table H ). DexDICE keeps the group-averaged cost below the constraint and attains the highest mean episode return among safe methods on all three benchmarks; per task, it satisfies the cost constraint on 31 31 of 38 38 tasks and is the best safe method on 19 19 . BC, JFBC, DWBC-S, FISOR-IL, and DemoDICE-U frequently violate safety; CDT and TraC become safer under pseudo-labels but at substantial return cost. DexDICE’s margin over DemoDICE-S/-U confirms that distribution matching biases the policy toward suboptimal safe behaviors, whereas the support constraint preserves high performance within safe regions (further comparisons against SafeDICE, COptiDICE, ICSDICE in Appendix G.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 报告了按组汇总的结果（逐任务结果见表 H ）。 DexDICE 使组平均代价保持在约束之下，并在全部三个基准上取得了安全方法中最高的平均回合回报；逐任务来看，它在 38 38 个任务中的 31 31 个上满足代价约束，并在 19 19 个任务上是最佳安全方法。 BC、JFBC、DWBC-S、FISOR-IL 和 DemoDICE-U 频繁违反安全性；CDT 和 TraC 在伪标签下变得更安全，但付出了相当大的回报代价。 DexDICE 相对于 DemoDICE-S/-U 的优势证实了分布匹配会使策略偏向次优的安全行为，而支撑约束则能在安全区域内保持高性能（与 SafeDICE、COptiDICE、ICSDICE 的进一步比较见附录 G.3 ）。

paragraphs.en: To address Q2 (data efficiency) and Q3 (quality robustness), we construct controlled datasets on six Safety Gymnasium tasks spanning the Circle and Velocity families by mixing four policy types ( safe-high , safe-medium , unsafe-high , unsafe-medium ): 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} combines safe-high / safe-medium , 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} combines safe-high / unsafe-high , and 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} contains all four (Appendix G.2 ). For Q2 , we sweep N 𝒟 P N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}} or N 𝒟 S ∈ { 2 , 6 , 10 , 14 , 20 } N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}}\in\{2,6,10,14,20\} with the other at 10; for Q3 , we fix N 𝒟 P = N 𝒟 S = 20 N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}}{=}N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}}{=}20 and sweep quality ​ ( 𝒟 P ) \textbf{quality}(\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}) or quality ​ ( 𝒟 S ) ∈ { 5 % , 25 % , 50 % , 75 % , 95 % } \textbf{quality}(\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}})\in\{5\%,25\%,50\%,75\%,95\%\} with the other at 50 % 50\% , where quality ​ ( 𝒟 ) \textbf{quality}(\mathcal{D}) is the safe-high fraction. Each controlled dataset requires training four policies per task, limiting the ablation to this representative subset.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答Q2（数据效率）和Q3（质量鲁棒性）问题，我们在六个涵盖 Circle 和 Velocity 两个系列的 Safety Gymnasium 任务上，通过混合四种策略类型（safe-high、safe-medium、unsafe-high、unsafe-medium）构建了受控数据集：𝒟_S 由 safe-high / safe-medium 组成，𝒟_P 由 safe-high / unsafe-high 组成，𝒟_U 则包含全部四种（见附录 G.2）。 对于 Q2，我们将 N_{𝒟_P} 或 N_{𝒟_S} ∈ {2, 6, 10, 14, 20} 进行扫描，另一个固定为 10；对于 Q3，我们固定 N_{𝒟_P} = N_{𝒟_S} = 20，并扫描 quality(𝒟_P) 或 quality(𝒟_S) ∈ {5%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 95%}，另一个固定为 50%，其中 quality(𝒟) 表示 safe-high 的比例。 每个受控数据集都需要在每个任务上训练四个策略，因此消融实验仅限于这一具有代表性的子集。

paragraphs.en: To address Q4 , we next ask whether DexDICE can learn from human-collected demonstrations and survive deployment on real hardware beyond simulation. We use a SUMMIT-XL-Steel mobile robot with a 2D LiDAR for goal-reaching navigation with intermediate obstacles. A single operator records N = 114 N{=}114 joystick teleoperation episodes: 10 aggressive runs (fast, possibly unsafe) form 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , 10 conservative runs (safe, slow) form 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} , and the remaining 94 episodes together with 𝒟 P ∪ 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}\cup\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} form 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} . To smooth control outputs and prevent actuator stress, we apply action chunking [ 69 ] uniformly across methods. Hardware, MDP, training, and evaluation details are in Appendix H .

paragraphs.en: Despite hardware-induced uncertainty and only 20 directed human episodes, DexDICE is the only method that reaches the goal in every trial with zero safety violations (Figure 3 (b)). BC-Safe, which uses safe demonstrations only, is safer than FBC/FISOR-IL but its conservatism more than doubles time-to-goal; FBC and FISOR-IL match expert speed but violate safety frequently; DemoDICE-U closely tracks DexDICE yet misses the goal in 2 / 10 2/10 trials. These results show that the advantages observed on the simulated benchmarks carry over to a noisy, human-driven physical setting (per-trial analysis in Figure J in Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在硬件带来的不确定性，且只有20条人类引导的示教片段，DexDICE 是唯一一种在每次试验中都能到达目标且零安全违规的方法（图3 (b)）。 仅使用安全示教数据的 BC-Safe 比 FBC/FISOR-IL 更安全，但其保守性使到达目标的时间增加了一倍以上；FBC 和 FISOR-IL 能达到专家速度，但频繁违反安全约束；DemoDICE-U 的表现与 DexDICE 接近，但在 2 / 10 2/10 次试验中未能到达目标。 这些结果表明，在仿真基准上观察到的优势可以延续到充满噪声、由人类驱动的物理环境中（逐试验分析见附录 H 中的图 J）。

paragraphs.en: We proposed DexDICE, a framework for learning safe and performant policies from dual-expert demonstrations in the offline regime, without relying on explicit reward or cost signals. By replacing distributional regularization toward d S d_{\mathrm{S}} with a safe support constraint, DexDICE decouples safety from the safe expert’s suboptimality: it attains the highest return among constraint-satisfying methods on all three families of the re-curated DSRL benchmark, remains data-efficient and robust to demonstration quality, and transfers to a real mobile robot trained from human teleoperation, reaching the goal in every trial without a safety violation. The support constraint further admits a high-probability zero-unsafe-visitation guarantee for the ideal support-constrained policy, calibrated by a single parameter.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DexDICE，一个在离线设定下从双专家演示中学习安全且高性能策略的框架，无需依赖显式的奖励或代价信号。 通过将对 d S d_{\mathrm{S}} 的分布式正则化替换为安全支持约束，DexDICE 将安全性与安全专家的次优性解耦：在重新整理的 DSRL 基准的全部三个任务族上，它在所有满足约束的方法中取得了最高回报，同时保持数据高效并对演示质量具有鲁棒性，并且从人类遥操作训练后可迁移到真实的移动机器人上，在每次试验中都到达目标且没有发生安全违规。 该支持约束进一步为理想的支持约束策略提供了一个由单一参数校准的高概率零不安全访问保证。

paragraphs.en: Our approach has two main limitations. First, as in any constrained formulation, the dual-expert IL problem requires a feasibility condition: non-trivial overlap between safe and performant demonstrations and a separable safe support. Our controlled studies show graceful degradation over a wide range of overlap levels, with failures only under extreme scarcity. Second, the exact guarantee concerns the ideal policy yet the weighted BC policy in practice need not be hard-supported. This gap cannot be eliminated in general, but deployment-time projection substantially reduces it at a modest cost in return (Appendix G.11 ). The conditions of Theorem 3 are population-level and are monitored through empirical diagnostics rather than certified (Appendix G.7 ), and results depend on the dataset-construction thresholds, to which we report sensitivity (Appendix G.10 ). A promising direction for future work is to extend our framework to handle multiple safety constraints or multi-objective settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法有两个主要局限。 首先，与任何带约束的表述一样，双专家模仿学习（dual-expert IL）问题需要一个可行性条件：安全示范与高性能示范之间存在非平凡的交集，且安全支撑集可分离。 我们的受控实验表明，在广泛的交集水平范围内性能会平缓退化，仅在极端稀缺的情况下才会失败。 其次，精确的保证针对的是理想策略，而实践中的加权行为克隆（BC）策略未必被硬支撑。 这一差距通常无法完全消除，但部署时的投影能以适度的回报代价大幅缩小该差距（附录 G.11）。 定理 3 的条件是总体层面的，我们通过经验性诊断加以监测而非进行认证（附录 G.7），且结果依赖于数据集构建的阈值，我们报告了对此的敏感性分析（附录 G.10）。 未来工作的一个有前景的方向是将我们的框架扩展到处理多重安全约束或多目标设置。

paragraphs.en: In practice, demonstrations may be collected from multiple safe policies and multiple performant policies, instead of just one π S \pi_{\mathrm{S}} and one π P \pi_{\mathrm{P}} . This general case is also covered by our setup. A finite set of demonstrations from multiple policies can be viewed as a demonstration set of a single policy obtained by a convex combination of the original multiple policies. Furthermore, if all those original policies are safe (i.e., they are all in Π S , δ c \Pi_{\mathrm{S},\delta_{c}} ), so is their convex combination. Similarly, if the policies are performant (i.e., they belong to Π P , δ r \Pi_{\mathrm{P},\delta_{r}} ), so is their convex combination. Thus, the general case can be understood as an instance of our problem where π S \pi_{\mathrm{S}} and π P \pi_{\mathrm{P}} are appropriate convex combinations of multiple safe and performant policies, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，示范数据可能从多个安全策略和多个高性能策略中收集，而不仅仅来自单一的 π S \pi_{\mathrm{S}} 和单一的 π P \pi_{\mathrm{P}} 。 这种一般情形也被我们的设定所覆盖。 来自多个策略的有限示范集可以被视为单一策略的示范集，该单一策略是原始多个策略的凸组合。 此外，如果所有这些原始策略都是安全的（即它们都属于 Π S , δ c \Pi_{\mathrm{S},\delta_{c}} ），那么它们的凸组合也是安全的。 类似地，如果这些策略是高性能的（即它们属于 Π P , δ r \Pi_{\mathrm{P},\delta_{r}} ），那么它们的凸组合也是高性能的。 因此，这种一般情形可以理解为我们的问题的一个实例，其中 π S \pi_{\mathrm{S}} 和 π P \pi_{\mathrm{P}} 分别是多个安全策略和高性能策略的适当凸组合。

paragraphs.en: any feasible d d must satisfy d ⁡ ( s , a ) = 0 d(s,a)=0 outside supp ⁡ ( d S ) \mathrm{supp}(d_{\mathrm{S}}) , while d P d_{\mathrm{P}} assigns mass exclusively outside this region. Hence no feasible d d is absolutely continuous with respect to d P d_{\mathrm{P}} , and the feasibility condition ( 10 ) is violated. Under the KL divergence used throughout this paper, this means D KL ( d ∥ d P ) = + ∞ D_{\mathrm{KL}}(d\,\|\,d_{\mathrm{P}})=+\infty for every feasible d d , so the optimization is degenerate and admits no finite minimizer in this regime. For broader choices of 𝔻 \mathbb{D} that remain finite without absolute continuity (e.g., total variation or Wasserstein), the problem is well-posed but reduces to selecting the feasible d d that minimizes 𝔻 ( d ∥ d P ) \mathbb{D}(d\,\|\,d_{\mathrm{P}}) within supp ⁡ ( d S ) \mathrm{supp}(d_{\mathrm{S}}) , a degenerate solution whose support is disjoint from d P d_{\mathrm{P}} and therefore cannot meaningfully imitate it. In either case, dual-expert IL collapses to imitating only the safe demonstrations, even when d P d_{\mathrm{P}} lies entirely outside the safe support. This limitation is also inherent to constrained optimization and is directly analogous to constrained RL: when the constraint is overly strict, no policy that attains sufficiently high return can satisfy the constrained RL objective.

paragraphs.en: The feasibility condition does not require a dataset of entire trajectories that are jointly safe and performant; it requires the separately collected sources to share enough state-action support to admit a Bellman-flow-feasible policy, which can hold even when the two demonstrators differ substantially at the trajectory level. Representative cases include: (i) autonomous driving, where human driver logs contain both fast, risky maneuvers and rule-compliant driving [ 3 , 10 ] , and the overlap consists of efficient routes that still respect the limits; (ii) human-robot collaboration, where a manipulator moves fast when the workspace is clear but slows near a person [ 36 ] , so that efficient-and-safe motions populate the overlap; and (iii) changing safety regulations, where a revised rule (e.g., updated speed limits, no-go zones, or clearance standards) redefines the safe region, so that only the safe demonstrations need re-collecting or re-labeling while the performant demonstrations remain reusable, and the overlap is the efficient behavior that still complies. The last case is precisely where labeling demonstrations is cheaper than re-engineering a reward or cost function. Our real-robot navigation experiment (Section 5.3 ) is a further instance: safe demonstrations keep clearance from obstacles, performant ones take faster routes, and the overlap is the set of fast routes that pass through safe corridors.
paragraphs.zh: 可行性条件并不需要一个由整体轨迹组成、同时兼具安全性与高性能的数据集；它只要求分别采集的数据源共享足够的状态-动作支撑，使得存在一个满足Bellman流可行性条件的策略，即使两个示教者在轨迹层面差异很大，这一条件也可能成立。 典型案例包括：(i) 自动驾驶，人类驾驶员的日志中既包含快速、有风险的驾驶操作，也包含遵守规则的驾驶行为 [ 3 , 10 ] ，二者的重叠是既高效又仍遵守限制的行驶路线；(ii) 人机协作，机械臂在工作空间无障碍时快速移动，但在靠近人员时会减速 [ 36 ] ，从而高效且安全的动作构成了重叠区域；以及 (iii) 安全法规变化，修订后的规则（例如更新的限速、禁行区域或安全间距标准）重新定义了安全区域，此时只需重新采集或重新标注安全示教数据，而高性能示教数据仍可复用，其重叠部分是仍然符合规定的高效行为。 最后一种情况正是标注示教数据比重新设计奖励函数或代价函数更廉价的场景。 我们的真实机器人导航实验（第 5.3 节）是又一个实例：安全示教数据与障碍物保持安全间距，高性能示教数据选择更快的路线，而重叠部分则是穿过安全通道的快速路线的集合。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide a detailed discussion of DICE-based approaches developed for offline learning problems that are closely related to our setting. Table A summarizes representative methods in terms of required learning signals, safety considerations, and dataset requirements. DICE methods have been widely studied in both RL and IL because they bypass explicit sequential modeling of MDP dynamics by optimizing over stationary distributions constrained to satisfy the Bellman flow condition. This perspective leads to linear programming objectives with tractable convex dual forms, making DICE formulations particularly appealing for offline settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们对为与本设定密切相关的离线学习问题而开发的基于 DICE 的方法进行详细讨论。 表 A 从所需学习信号、安全考量以及数据集要求等方面总结了代表性方法。 DICE 方法在强化学习和模仿学习中都得到了广泛研究，因为它们通过在满足贝尔曼流条件约束的平稳分布上进行优化，避免了对 MDP 动力学的显式序列建模。 这一视角带来了具有易处理的凸对偶形式的线性规划目标，使得 DICE 公式在离线场景中尤为具有吸引力。

paragraphs.en: This section elaborates on the offline safe RL methods discussed in Section 2 , why they are not directly applicable to the dual-expert IL setting, and how we adapt them for the comparison reported in Section 5.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细阐述第 2 节中讨论的离线安全强化学习方法，说明它们为何不能直接应用于双专家模仿学习（IL）设置，以及我们如何对它们进行调整以用于第 5.1 节中报告的对比实验。

paragraphs.en: These methods take a constrained MDP as input, with explicit per-transition reward r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) and cost c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a) provided in the offline dataset, and learn a policy that maximizes return subject to a cost budget.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法以约束马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）作为输入，离线数据集中提供了每个状态转移的显式奖励 r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) 和代价 c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a)，并学习一个在代价预算约束下最大化回报的策略。

paragraphs.en: COptiDICE [ 39 ] extends OptiDICE [ 38 ] to constrained MDPs by introducing a Lagrangian term for the cost expectation.
paragraphs.zh: COptiDICE [39] 通过为代价期望引入拉格朗日项，将 OptiDICE [38] 扩展到约束马尔可夫决策过程。

paragraphs.en: CDT [ 43 ] conditions a Decision Transformer [ 12 ] on both return-to-go and cost-to-go targets computed from each trajectory’s reward and cost signals.
paragraphs.zh: CDT [ 43 ] 将决策 Transformer [ 12 ] 以每个轨迹的奖励和代价信号计算出的 return-to-go 和 cost-to-go 目标为条件。

paragraphs.en: FISOR [ 70 ] casts safety as a reachability problem, learning a cost value function V c V_{c} from c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a) and using it to mask infeasible actions for a guided diffusion policy.
paragraphs.zh: FISOR [70] 将安全性视为可达性问题，从 c(s,a) 学习代价价值函数 V_{c}，并利用它来屏蔽不可行动作，从而引导扩散策略。

paragraphs.en: C2IQL [ 42 ] extends IQL with a Lagrangian dual: separate Q-functions for reward and cost are learned via expectile regression and balanced by a learnable multiplier.
paragraphs.zh: C2IQL [42] 通过拉格朗日对偶扩展了 IQL：通过期望分位数回归分别学习奖励和成本的 Q 函数，并通过可学习的乘子进行平衡。

paragraphs.en: TraC [ 18 ] reframes offline safe RL as trajectory classification: trajectories are scored by predicted return and total cost, then weighted behavioral cloning recovers the policy.
paragraphs.zh: TraC [18] 将离线安全强化学习重新构建为轨迹分类问题：先根据预测回报和总成本对轨迹进行评分，然后通过加权行为克隆恢复策略。

paragraphs.en: All five methods consume per-transition ( r , c ) (r,c) supervision, which our dual-expert IL setting does not provide.
paragraphs.zh: 所有五种方法都需要每个转移 ( r , c ) (r,c) 的监督信号，而我们的双专家模仿学习（IL）设置并不提供这种监督。

paragraphs.en: This labeling is biased in two ways. First, 𝟙 [ ( s , a ) ∉ 𝒟 S ] \mathds{1}[(s,a)\notin\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}] marks every transition outside 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} as unsafe, including a substantial number of safe transitions in 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} , since 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} is a latent mixture of safe and unsafe behavior. Second, 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} contains only positive (safe) examples while 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} is unlabeled rather than negative; this is exactly the positive–unlabeled (PU) learning regime [ 5 , 16 ] , in which naive binary classification systematically over-estimates the negative class. Cost Q-functions trained on such biased labels inflate the unsafe region, leading either to overly conservative behavior or to unreliable feasibility masks that admit unsafe actions.
paragraphs.zh: 这种标注方式在两个方面存在偏差。 首先，𝟙 [ ( s , a ) ∉ 𝒟 S ] \mathds{1}[(s,a)\notin\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}] 会将 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 之外的所有转移都标记为不安全，其中包括 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 中大量安全的转移，因为 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 是安全与不安全行为的潜在混合体。 其次，𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 只包含正例（安全样本），而 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 是未标注的而非负例；这正是正–未标注（PU）学习范式 [ 5 , 16 ] ，在其中朴素的二分类会系统性地高估负类。 在这种有偏标签上训练的代价 Q 函数会夸大不安全区域，导致行为过于保守，或者产生不可靠的可行性掩码，从而允许不安全的动作。

paragraphs.en: This section provides the full statement and proof of the safety guarantee informally stated as Theorem 3 in the main paper, relating the policy’s unsafe-region visitation to the discriminator’s error rates.
paragraphs.zh: 本节完整给出主文中以定理 3 非正式陈述的安全保证的完整表述与证明，该定理将策略访问不安全区域的情况与判别器的错误率联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Consider a constrained MDP with state space 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . We are given three offline datasets 𝒟 S , 𝒟 P , 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} , with stationary state-action distributions d S , d P , d U d_{\mathrm{S}},d_{\mathrm{P}},d_{\mathrm{U}} . Let 𝒩 env ⊆ 𝒮 × 𝒜 \mathcal{N}_{\mathrm{env}}\subseteq\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A} denote the set of state-action pairs that are unsafe in the environment. We assume pointwise soundness of the safe demonstrations, supp ⁡ ( d S ) ∩ 𝒩 env = ∅ \operatorname{supp}(d_{\mathrm{S}})\cap\mathcal{N}_{\mathrm{env}}=\emptyset , i.e., every demonstrated safe pair is environmentally safe. Under this assumption, agreement with the demonstrated support implies environmental safety, so the zero-visitation guarantee below for the unsafe region 𝐍 \mathbf{N} (the reachable complement of the demonstrated safe support) is a statement about environmental safety; without it, the guarantee concerns support agreement only. paragraphs.en: None of the assumptions requires exact recovery of the safe region, its density, or a cost function. Pointwise soundness requires only that 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} be uncontaminated, not that it cover the full safe region. Assumption C requires a uniform bound on the discriminator score rather than recovery of either density, and Assumption E requires a margin only on the retained safe interior. Both are standard plug-in conditions for thresholded density-ratio classifiers [ 62 ] . Since these are population-level conditions, their empirical diagnostics are reported in Appendices G.7 and G.8 .
paragraphs.zh: 任何假设都不要求精确恢复安全区域、其密度或某个代价函数。 逐点可靠性只要求 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 未被污染，而不要求它覆盖完整的安全区域。 假设 C 要求判别器得分具有一致上界，而不是恢复任何一种密度；假设 E 只要求在保留的安全内部上留有余量。 两者都是基于阈值化密度比分类器的标准插件式条件 [ 62 ] 。 由于这些是总体层面的条件，其经验诊断结果在附录 G.7 和 G.8 中报告。

paragraphs.en: This section details the simulation experiments on 38 re-curated DSRL tasks and six controlled Safety Gymnasium tasks. It covers dataset construction (Sections G.1 and G.2 ), extended baseline comparisons, hyperparameters, data efficiency and quality, support-estimator comparisons, sensitivity to the target FNR and dataset construction thresholds, robustness to noisy safe demonstrations, and deployment-time projection.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细介绍在 38 个重新整理的 DSRL 任务和六个受控的 Safety Gymnasium 任务上开展的仿真实验。 内容涵盖数据集构建（G.1 节和 G.2 节）、扩展的基线对比、超参数、数据效率与质量、支持集估计器对比、对目标 FNR 和数据集构建阈值的敏感性、对含噪安全示范的鲁棒性，以及部署时的投影。

sents.en: This section details the simulation experiments on 38 re-curated DSRL tasks and six controlled Safety Gymnasium tasks.
sents.zh: 本节详细介绍在 38 个重新整理的 DSRL 任务和六个受控的 Safety Gymnasium 任务上开展的仿真实验。

sents.en: It covers dataset construction (Sections G.1 and G.2 ), extended baseline comparisons, hyperparameters, data efficiency and quality, support-estimator comparisons, sensitivity to the target FNR and dataset construction thresholds, robustness to noisy safe demonstrations, and deployment-time projection.
sents.zh: 内容涵盖数据集构建（G.1 节和 G.2 节）、扩展的基线对比、超参数、数据效率与质量、支持集估计器对比、对目标 FNR 和数据集构建阈值的敏感性、对含噪安全示范的鲁棒性，以及部署时的投影。

paragraphs.en: The original DSRL datasets [ 44 ] were constructed by aggregating demonstrations from policies trained with a range of safe RL algorithms, resulting in a diverse set of pre-collected trajectories. Each trajectory records both its episode return and cost, which allows us to partition the dataset into dual-expert subsets through thresholding. To define these subsets, we adopted cost thresholds from the original DSRL paper (specifically, one of { 20 , 40 , 80 } \{20,40,80\} ) and classified trajectories as safe if their cumulative cost was below the corresponding threshold, or unsafe otherwise. For the return threshold, we selected the 90th percentile of returns among the safe trajectories. Sensitivity to both thresholds is analyzed in Appendix G.10 . With these criteria, each trajectory is categorized into one of four groups: performant ( 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} ), safe ( 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ), non-preferred ( 𝒟 N \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{N}} ), or unlabeled ( 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} ), based on its safety and performance relative to the thresholds. The non-preferred set is exclusively used in the SafeDICE experiments. Table B summarizes the characteristics and statistics for each task category in the re-curated DSRL benchmark. For brevity, task names in the tables and analyses are abbreviated where appropriate by omitting repeated prefixes (e.g., ‘Safety’, ‘Safe’) and environment-version suffixes (e.g., ‘-v0’, ‘-v1’).
paragraphs.zh: 原始 DSRL 数据集 [44] 是通过聚合由多种安全强化学习算法训练的策略所产生的演示而构建的，从而形成了一组多样化的预收集轨迹。 每条轨迹都记录了其回合回报和代价，这使我们能够通过阈值划分将数据集划分为双专家子集。 为了定义这些子集，我们采用了原始 DSRL 论文中的代价阈值（具体为 {20, 40, 80} \{20,40,80\} 之一），并将累积代价低于相应阈值的轨迹分类为安全，否则分类为不安全。 对于回报阈值，我们选取了安全轨迹中回报的第 90 百分位数。 对这两个阈值的敏感性分析见附录 G.10。 基于这些标准，每条轨迹根据其相对于阈值的安全性和性能被归入四组之一：高性能（𝒟_P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}）、安全（𝒟_S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}）、非偏好（𝒟_N \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{N}}）或未标注（𝒟_U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}）。 非偏好集合仅在 SafeDICE 实验中使用。 表 B 总结了重新整理的 DSRL 基准中每个任务类别的特征和统计数据。 为简洁起见，表格和分析中的任务名称在适当情况下通过省略重复前缀（例如 'Safety'、'Safe'）和环境版本后缀（例如 '-v0'、'-v1'）进行缩写。

paragraphs.en: We detail the data labeling process for each demonstration category below:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在下面详细介绍每个演示类别的数据标注流程：

paragraphs.en: safe : demonstrations whose cumulative cost remains below the predefined cost threshold, regardless of their return.
paragraphs.zh: safe : 累积代价低于预定代价阈值的演示，无论其回报如何。

paragraphs.en: performant : demonstrations whose return exceeds the predefined return threshold, regardless of their cost.
paragraphs.zh: 高性能的：回报超过预设回报阈值的演示，无论其成本如何。

paragraphs.en: non-preferred : demonstrations whose cumulative cost exceeds the cost threshold (i.e., unsafe trajectories).
paragraphs.zh: 非偏好样本：累计成本超过成本阈值的演示（即不安全轨迹）。

paragraphs.en: unlabeled : the full set of offline trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 未标注：完整的离线轨迹集合。

paragraphs.en: To systematically study the influence of (1) the number of trajectories and (2) the quality of datasets, we construct controlled datasets with varying levels of safety and performance ; the Safety Gymnasium tasks used for this purpose are described in Table G . This involves collecting demonstrations from policies exhibiting different performance (e.g., near-optimal, medium) and safety (e.g., safe, unsafe) characteristics. We utilize the OmniSafe framework [ 29 ] , which provides a suite of safe RL algorithms for the Safety Gymnasium benchmark [ 28 ] , to generate policies for data collection.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统地研究 (1) 轨迹数量和 (2) 数据集质量的影响，我们构建了具有不同安全性和性能水平的受控数据集；为此所使用的 Safety Gymnasium 任务见表 G。 这涉及从具有不同性能（例如，接近最优、中等）和安全性（例如，安全、不安全）特征的策略中收集示范数据。 我们利用 OmniSafe 框架 [ 29 ] 来生成用于数据收集的策略，该框架为 Safety Gymnasium 基准 [ 28 ] 提供了一套安全强化学习算法。

sents.en: To systematically study the influence of (1) the number of trajectories and (2) the quality of datasets, we construct controlled datasets with varying levels of safety and performance ; the Safety Gymnasium tasks used for this purpose are described in Table G .

sents.zh: 这涉及从具有不同性能（例如，接近最优、中等）和安全性（例如，安全、不安全）特征的策略中收集示范数据。

sents.en: We utilize the OmniSafe framework [ 29 ] , which provides a suite of safe RL algorithms for the Safety Gymnasium benchmark [ 28 ] , to generate policies for data collection.
sents.zh: 我们利用 OmniSafe 框架 [ 29 ] 来生成用于数据收集的策略，该框架为 Safety Gymnasium 基准 [ 28 ] 提供了一套安全强化学习算法。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we employ PPO [ 56 ] for unconstrained MDPs and PPO-Lag [ 52 ] for constrained MDPs (CMDPs) with explicit cost limits. Using these algorithms, we train near-optimal policies for both settings: PPO-Lag yields the safe-high dataset (cost-constrained, high return) and PPO yields the unsafe-high dataset (unconstrained, high return).
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们在无约束 MDP 中采用 PPO [56]，在具有显式成本约束的受限 MDP（CMDP）中采用 PPO-Lag [52]。 利用这些算法，我们为两种设置训练出接近最优的策略：PPO-Lag 生成安全-高数据集（受成本约束、高回报），PPO 生成不安全-高数据集（无约束、高回报）。

sents.en: Specifically, we employ PPO [ 56 ] for unconstrained MDPs and PPO-Lag [ 52 ] for constrained MDPs (CMDPs) with explicit cost limits.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们在无约束 MDP 中采用 PPO [56]，在具有显式成本约束的受限 MDP（CMDP）中采用 PPO-Lag [52]。

sents.en: Using these algorithms, we train near-optimal policies for both settings: PPO-Lag yields the safe-high dataset (cost-constrained, high return) and PPO yields the unsafe-high dataset (unconstrained, high return).
sents.zh: 利用这些算法，我们为两种设置训练出接近最优的策略：PPO-Lag 生成安全-高数据集（受成本约束、高回报），PPO 生成不安全-高数据集（无约束、高回报）。

paragraphs.en: To acquire the safe-medium and unsafe-medium datasets, we identify policies whose performance is approximately half that of the corresponding near-optimal policy. We ensure that the safe-medium policies continue to satisfy cost constraints, whereas the unsafe-medium policies violate these constraints by design.
paragraphs.zh: 为了获取安全中等和 不安全中等数据集，我们选取性能约为相应近优策略一半的策略。 我们确保安全中等策略继续满足成本约束，而不安全中等策略则被刻意设计为违反这些约束。

sents.en: To acquire the safe-medium and unsafe-medium datasets, we identify policies whose performance is approximately half that of the corresponding near-optimal policy.
sents.zh: 为了获取安全中等和 不安全中等数据集，我们选取性能约为相应近优策略一半的策略。

sents.en: We ensure that the safe-medium policies continue to satisfy cost constraints, whereas the unsafe-medium policies violate these constraints by design.
sents.zh: 我们确保安全中等策略继续满足成本约束，而不安全中等策略则被刻意设计为违反这些约束。

paragraphs.en: For the data efficiency ( Q2 ) and data quality ( Q3 ) experiments (see Section 5.2 ), we conduct evaluations on six representative tasks: SafetyPointCircle1, SafetyPointCircle2, SafetyHopperVelocity, SafetyHalfCheetahVelocity, SafetyWalker2dVelocity, and SafetyAntVelocity.
paragraphs.zh: 针对数据效率（ Q2 ）和数据质量（ Q3 ）实验（见第 5.2 节），我们在六个代表性任务上进行评估：SafetyPointCircle1、SafetyPointCircle2、SafetyHopperVelocity、SafetyHalfCheetahVelocity、SafetyWalker2dVelocity 和 SafetyAntVelocity。

paragraphs.en: In this section we compare DexDICE with a broader set of baselines from two families that operate under different supervision settings: DICE-based methods (SafeDICE [ 26 ] , COptiDICE [ 39 ] , ICSDICE [ 51 ] ) and offline safe RL methods (CDT [ 43 ] , FISOR [ 70 ] , TraC [ 18 ] ). Despite their differing assumptions, all are evaluated under our safety and return metrics for conceptual and practical comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将 DexDICE 与来自两个家族、在不同监督设置下运行的更广泛的基线方法集合进行比较：基于 DICE 的方法（SafeDICE [26]、COptiDICE [39]、ICSDICE [51]）和离线安全强化学习方法（CDT [43]、FISOR [70]、TraC [18]）。 尽管它们的假设各不相同，但为了概念上和实用上的比较，所有方法都在我们的安全性和回报指标下进行评估。

sents.en: In this section we compare DexDICE with a broader set of baselines from two families that operate under different supervision settings: DICE-based methods (SafeDICE [ 26 ] , COptiDICE [ 39 ] , ICSDICE [ 51 ] ) and offline safe RL methods (CDT [ 43 ] , FISOR [ 70 ] , TraC [ 18 ] ).
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将 DexDICE 与来自两个家族、在不同监督设置下运行的更广泛的基线方法集合进行比较：基于 DICE 的方法（SafeDICE [26]、COptiDICE [39]、ICSDICE [51]）和离线安全强化学习方法（CDT [43]、FISOR [70]、TraC [18]）。

sents.en: Despite their differing assumptions, all are evaluated under our safety and return metrics for conceptual and practical comparison.
sents.zh: 尽管它们的假设各不相同，但为了概念上和实用上的比较，所有方法都在我们的安全性和回报指标下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: SafeDICE treats unsafe demonstrations as non-preferred. COptiDICE, CDT, FISOR, and TraC use ground-truth reward r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) and cost c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a) from the dataset. ICSDICE uses true rewards and safe demonstrations 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} . DexDICE is trained using only 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} , 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , and 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} . Its per-task best κ \kappa in Table I is selected post hoc using evaluation return and cost, separately from the fixed- κ \kappa main result.
paragraphs.zh: SafeDICE 将不安全演示视为非偏好数据。 COptiDICE、CDT、FISOR 和 TraC 使用数据集中的真实奖励 r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) 和代价 c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a)。 ICSDICE 使用真实奖励和安全演示 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}。 DexDICE 仅使用 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}、𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 和 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 进行训练。 其在表 I 中的每个任务最优 κ \kappa 是事后使用评估回报和代价选出的，与固定 κ \kappa 的主要结果分开。

sents.en: SafeDICE treats unsafe demonstrations as non-preferred.
sents.zh: SafeDICE 将不安全演示视为非偏好数据。

sents.en: COptiDICE, CDT, FISOR, and TraC use ground-truth reward r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) and cost c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a) from the dataset.
sents.zh: COptiDICE、CDT、FISOR 和 TraC 使用数据集中的真实奖励 r ⁡ ( s , a ) r(s,a) 和代价 c ⁡ ( s , a ) c(s,a)。

sents.en: ICSDICE uses true rewards and safe demonstrations 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} .
sents.zh: ICSDICE 使用真实奖励和安全演示 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}。

sents.en: DexDICE is trained using only 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} , 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} , and 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} .
sents.zh: DexDICE 仅使用 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}、𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 和 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 进行训练。

sents.en: Its per-task best κ \kappa in Table I is selected post hoc using evaluation return and cost, separately from the fixed- κ \kappa main result.
sents.zh: 其在表 I 中的每个任务最优 κ \kappa 是事后使用评估回报和代价选出的，与固定 κ \kappa 的主要结果分开。

paragraphs.en: With the fixed κ = 0.01 \kappa=0.01 used in the main result, DexDICE satisfies the cost constraint on 31 31 of the 38 38 tasks (Table H ). Table I separately reports the exploratory comparison using DexDICE’s post hoc per-task best κ \kappa . Within the DICE family, SafeDICE violates the cost constraint on 20 20 of the 38 38 tasks since its non-preferred set does not adequately cover the unsafe support, leaving exploitable gaps. COptiDICE, despite ground-truth reward and cost access, violates the constraint on 19 19 tasks, consistent with the observation in the DSRL paper [ 44 ] that behavior-distribution constraints (e.g., D f ( d ∥ d U ) D_{f}(d\|d_{\mathrm{U}}) ) induce conservatism and brittle safety under lower-quality data. ICSDICE attains the highest returns on average but violates the constraint on 22 22 tasks, concentrated in the velocity, Bullet Safety Gym, and MetaDrive tasks. Among offline safe RL methods, FISOR, FISOR-IL, and TraC satisfy the constraint on 34 34 , 35 35 , and 30 30 tasks, respectively, under full ground-truth supervision but pay a notable return cost; their constrained-RL formulations bias the policy toward conservative behavior even when the dataset already contains high-return safe trajectories. CDT attains higher returns but violates the constraint on 18 18 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 使用主结果中固定的 κ=0.01，DexDICE 在 38 个任务中的 31 个上满足代价约束（表 H）。 表 I 单独报告了使用 DexDICE 事后逐任务最优 κ 的探索性比较。 在 DICE 系列中，SafeDICE 在 38 个任务中的 20 个上违反了代价约束，因为其非偏好集未能充分覆盖不安全支撑，留下了可被利用的空隙。 COptiDICE 尽管可以访问真值奖励和代价，仍在 19 个任务上违反约束，这与 DSRL 论文 [44] 中的观察一致，即行为分布约束（例如 D_f(d∥d_U)）在较高质量较低的数据下会引发保守性和脆弱的安全性。 ICSDICE 取得了最高的平均回报，但在 22 个任务上违反约束，这些任务集中在速度、Bullet Safety Gym 和 MetaDrive 任务中。 在离线安全 RL 方法中，FISOR、FISOR-IL 和 TraC 在完整真值监督下分别在 34、35 和 30 个任务上满足约束，但付出了显著的回报代价；它们的约束式 RL 公式使策略偏向保守行为，即使数据集中已包含高回报的安全轨迹。 CDT 取得了更高的回报，但在 18 个任务上违反了约束。

sents.zh: 使用主结果中固定的 κ=0.01，DexDICE 在 38 个任务中的 31 个上满足代价约束（表 H）。

sents.en: Table I separately reports the exploratory comparison using DexDICE’s post hoc per-task best κ \kappa .
sents.zh: 表 I 单独报告了使用 DexDICE 事后逐任务最优 κ 的探索性比较。

sents.en: Within the DICE family, SafeDICE violates the cost constraint on 20 20 of the 38 38 tasks since its non-preferred set does not adequately cover the unsafe support, leaving exploitable gaps.

sents.en: COptiDICE, despite ground-truth reward and cost access, violates the constraint on 19 19 tasks, consistent with the observation in the DSRL paper [ 44 ] that behavior-distribution constraints (e.g., D f ( d ∥ d U ) D_{f}(d\|d_{\mathrm{U}}) ) induce conservatism and brittle safety under lower-quality data.
sents.zh: COptiDICE 尽管可以访问真值奖励和代价，仍在 19 个任务上违反约束，这与 DSRL 论文 [44] 中的观察一致，即行为分布约束（例如 D_f(d∥d_U)）在较高质量较低的数据下会引发保守性和脆弱的安全性。

sents.en: ICSDICE attains the highest returns on average but violates the constraint on 22 22 tasks, concentrated in the velocity, Bullet Safety Gym, and MetaDrive tasks.
sents.zh: ICSDICE 取得了最高的平均回报，但在 22 个任务上违反约束，这些任务集中在速度、Bullet Safety Gym 和 MetaDrive 任务中。

sents.en: Among offline safe RL methods, FISOR, FISOR-IL, and TraC satisfy the constraint on 34 34 , 35 35 , and 30 30 tasks, respectively, under full ground-truth supervision but pay a notable return cost; their constrained-RL formulations bias the policy toward conservative behavior even when the dataset already contains high-return safe trajectories.
sents.zh: 在离线安全 RL 方法中，FISOR、FISOR-IL 和 TraC 在完整真值监督下分别在 34、35 和 30 个任务上满足约束，但付出了显著的回报代价；它们的约束式 RL 公式使策略偏向保守行为，即使数据集中已包含高回报的安全轨迹。

sents.en: CDT attains higher returns but violates the constraint on 18 18 tasks.
sents.zh: CDT 取得了更高的回报，但在 18 个任务上违反了约束。

paragraphs.en: One of our core components is the support estimator constructed from unlabeled demonstrations proposed in Section 4.2 . To assess effectiveness of decision functions, we compare our approach against the following established baselines:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心组件之一是第 4.2 节提出的、由无标注演示构建的支持估计器。 为了评估决策函数的有效性，我们将我们的方法与以下已有的基线方法进行比较：

sents.en: One of our core components is the support estimator constructed from unlabeled demonstrations proposed in Section 4.2 .
sents.zh: 我们的核心组件之一是第 4.2 节提出的、由无标注演示构建的支持估计器。

sents.en: To assess effectiveness of decision functions, we compare our approach against the following established baselines:
sents.zh: 为了评估决策函数的有效性，我们将我们的方法与以下已有的基线方法进行比较：

paragraphs.en: GMM : a density-estimation approach based on fitting Gaussian mixture models [ 6 ] to approximate d S d_{\mathrm{S}} .
paragraphs.zh: GMM：一种基于拟合高斯混合模型 [ 6 ] 来近似 d S d_{\mathrm{S}} 的密度估计方法。

paragraphs.en: LOF (Local Outlier Factor) [ 8 ] : a non-parametric method that detects outliers by measuring the local deviation of a sample’s density relative to that of its neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: LOF（局部离群因子）[8]：一种非参数方法，通过测量样本密度相对于其邻居密度的局部偏差来检测离群点。

paragraphs.en: OCSVM (One-class Support Vector Machine) [ 55 ] : a kernel-based method that learns a hypersurface enclosing the majority of data, treating points outside the boundary as novelties.
paragraphs.zh: OCSVM（单类支持向量机）[ 55 ]：一种基于核的方法，通过学习一个包围大多数数据的超曲面，将边界之外的点视为异常点。

paragraphs.en: Deep SVDD (Deep Support Vector Data Description) [ 54 ] : a deep representation–based method that maps data into a latent space and minimizes the volume of a hypersphere enclosing the nominal samples.
paragraphs.zh: Deep SVDD（深度支持向量数据描述）[54]：一种基于深度表示的方法，将数据映射到潜在空间中，并最小化包围正常样本的超球体的体积。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table K , our method achieves the highest AUROC on 8 of 11 tasks, indicating consistently superior novelty-detection performance. This highlights the benefit of leveraging density-ratio estimation for reliable support estimation. We further examine how the choice of support estimator impacts safety and performance on DexDICE; the results are reported in Table L .
paragraphs.zh: 如表 K 所示，我们的方法在 11 个任务中的 8 个上取得了最高的 AUROC，表明其在新颖性检测方面具有持续优越的性能。 这凸显了利用密度比估计来实现可靠支持估计的好处。 我们进一步考察了支持估计器的选择对 DexDICE 上安全性和性能的影响；结果报告于表 L 中。

paragraphs.en: The re-curated DSRL benchmark labels trajectories as safe or performant using two thresholds (Appendix G.1 ): a cost threshold defining 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} and a return threshold defining 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} . These thresholds determine, respectively, the demonstration-defined safety support and the performance target. We therefore provide a one-at-a-time sensitivity sweep over both, on six tasks with N 𝒟 S = N 𝒟 P = 10 N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}}=N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}}=10 and 5 seeds, following the evaluation protocol of Table 1 . (i) We vary the cost threshold defining 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} from 0.5 × 0.5\times to 1.5 × 1.5\times the DSRL cost limit while holding the 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} threshold at its default (Table M ). (ii) We vary the return threshold defining 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} over the 50th, 75th, 90th, and 95th percentiles of safe trajectory returns, plus a threshold above the maximum safe trajectory return, while holding the 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} threshold at its default (Table N ). These thresholds change only the dataset labels; every policy is evaluated against the same fixed normalized cost bar of 1.0 1.0 defined by the original DSRL cost limit.
paragraphs.zh: 重新整理后的 DSRL 基准使用两个阈值将轨迹标记为安全或高性能（附录 G.1）：定义 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 的成本阈值和定义 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 的回报阈值。 这两个阈值分别确定了由演示定义的安全支撑集和性能目标。 因此，我们在六个 N 𝒟 S = N 𝒟 P = 10 N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}}}=N_{\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}}=10 且 5 个随机种子的任务上，按照表 1 的评估协议，对这两个阈值逐一进行了敏感性扫描。 (i) 我们将定义 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 的成本阈值从 DSRL 成本限制的 0.5 × 0.5\times 变化到 1.5 × 1.5\times，同时将 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 阈值保持为默认值（表 M）。 (ii) 我们将定义 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}} 的回报阈值在安全轨迹回报的第 50、75、90 和 95 百分位数之间变化，外加一个高于最大安全轨迹回报的阈值，同时将 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 阈值保持为默认值（表 N）。 这些阈值仅改变数据集的标签；每个策略都按照由原始 DSRL 成本限制定义的同一个固定归一化成本基准 1.0 1.0 进行评估。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the gap, we implement a finite-budget, gradient-based action projection at deployment time. Starting from the proposed action, the filter ascends the safe-support discriminator’s logit with respect to the action, clips every update to the action bounds, and terminates once r ^ S ​ ( s , a ) ≥ τ κ \hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}}(s,a)\geq\tau_{\kappa} ; steps at which the search budget is exhausted are logged. To obtain smoother support-score gradients for the projection, the safe-support discriminator’s gradient-penalty coefficient C S C_{\mathrm{S}} is raised from its default 0 0 (Table J ) to 10 10 , matching the performance discriminator’s setting C P = 10 C_{\mathrm{P}}=10 ; both rows of Table O use this setting. Exact support inclusion under such filtering would require every reached state s s to admit at least one action a a with ( s , a ) ∈ 𝐒 ^ τ κ (s,a)\in\hat{\mathbf{S}}_{\tau_{\kappa}} , which need not hold in general, and even then a finite-budget search may fail to find it. The residual mismatch after projection is therefore reported separately and is not covered by the exact guarantee. To obtain smoother support-score gradients for the projection, the safe-support discriminator’s gradient-penalty coefficient C S C_{\mathrm{S}} is set to 10 10 in this experiment (default 0 0 in Table J ), matching the performance discriminator’s setting C P = 10 C_{\mathrm{P}}=10 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们在部署时实现了一种有限预算、基于梯度的动作投影。 从所提出的动作出发，该过滤器沿安全支持判别器的 logit 关于动作进行上升，将每次更新裁剪到动作边界内，并在一旦满足 r ^ S ​ ( s , a ) ≥ τ κ \hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}}(s,a)\geq\tau_{\kappa} 时终止；搜索预算耗尽的步数会被记录下来。 为了给投影获得更平滑的支持分数梯度，将安全支持判别器的梯度惩罚系数 C S C_{\mathrm{S}} 从其默认值 0 0 （表 J）提高到 10 10，与性能判别器的设置 C P = 10 C_{\mathrm{P}}=10 一致；表 O 的两行均采用此设置。 在这种过滤下，精确的支持包含要求每个到达的状态 s s 都至少存在一个动作 a a 满足 ( s , a ) ∈ 𝐒 ^ τ κ (s,a)\in\hat{\mathbf{S}}_{\tau_{\kappa}}，这一条件在一般情况下并不必然成立，即便成立，有限预算的搜索也可能找不到这样的动作。 因此，投影后的残余失配被单独报告，并且不在精确保证的覆盖范围之内。 为了给投影获得更平滑的支持分数梯度，本实验中将安全支持判别器的梯度惩罚系数 C S C_{\mathrm{S}} 设为 10 10（表 J 中的默认值为 0 0），与性能判别器的设置 C P = 10 C_{\mathrm{P}}=10 一致。

sents.en: Starting from the proposed action, the filter ascends the safe-support discriminator’s logit with respect to the action, clips every update to the action bounds, and terminates once r ^ S ​ ( s , a ) ≥ τ κ \hat{r}_{\mathrm{S}}(s,a)\geq\tau_{\kappa} ; steps at which the search budget is exhausted are logged.

paragraphs.en: DexDICE is compared against four baselines trained on the same datasets and spaces: BC-Safe (Gaussian BC on 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} ), FBC (filtered BC with a discriminator-quantile filter), DemoDICE-U (DemoDICE with 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} as the extraction set), and FISOR-IL( c ^ \hat{c} ) , the offline-IL variant of FISOR [ 70 ] fed with a pseudo cost from a 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} -vs- ( 𝒟 U ∪ 𝒟 P ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}\cup\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}) discriminator.
paragraphs.zh: DexDICE 与四个在相同数据集和空间上训练的基线方法进行比较：BC-Safe（在 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 上的高斯 BC）、FBC（带判别器分位数过滤的过滤 BC）、DemoDICE-U（以 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}} 作为提取集的 DemoDICE），以及 FISOR-IL( c ^ \hat{c} )，即 FISOR [ 70 ] 的离线 IL 变体，其输入来自 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{S}} 与 ( 𝒟 U ∪ 𝒟 P ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{U}}\cup\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{P}}) 判别器产生的伪代价。

sents.en: Each method is trained for 10 6 10^{6} Adam steps with batch size 512 512 over 5 5 seeds; DexDICE uses target FNR κ = 0.2 \kappa{=}0.2 and initial Lagrange multiplier λ 0 = 5 \lambda_{0}{=}5 .
sents.zh: 每种方法在 5 个随机种子上以批量大小 512 训练 10^6 步 Adam；DexDICE 使用目标 FNR κ=0.2 和初始拉格朗日乘子 λ₀=5。

paragraphs.en: Before real-robot deployment, candidate policies must be validated for safe and sensible behavior to avoid hardware damage or unsafe trials. We perform this validation in a 2D simulator whose first-order velocity dynamics are calibrated to the real platform from teleoperation logs and whose arena/obstacle layout matches the physical setup.
paragraphs.zh: 在真机部署之前，必须对候选策略进行验证，以确保其行为安全合理，避免硬件损坏或不安全的尝试。 我们在一个二维仿真器中执行该验证，该仿真器的一阶速度动力学根据遥操作日志针对真实平台进行了标定，且其场地/障碍物布局与物理设置相匹配。

Real robot: 10 10 trials per method’s validated checkpoint via the same 10 10 Hz inference loop, providing the main-paper results in Section 5.3 .

paragraphs.en: Success rate : fraction of trials reaching the goal ( ‖ ( Δ ​ x , Δ ​ y ) ‖ < 0.50 \|(\Delta x,\Delta y)\|<0.50 m) without a collision (closest LiDAR beam ≥ d coll = 0.15 \geq d_{\mathrm{coll}}{=}0.15 m throughout).

paragraphs.en: Time-to-goal : mean episode duration over successful trials.
paragraphs.zh: 到达目标时间（Time-to-goal）：成功试验的平均回合时长。

paragraphs.en: BC-Safe is the safest cloning baseline, but its conservatism slows trajectories to ∼ 40 ​ s {\sim}40\,\text{s} and stalls two trials before reaching the goal. FBC matches expert speed but its support filter is too permissive on hardware, leading to obstacle clipping and collisions. FISOR-IL with pseudo-labeled cost shows a similar fast-but-unsafe profile to FBC, with violations spread more uniformly across the trajectory. DemoDICE-U is closest to DexDICE in both safety and speed; its two failures are timeouts driven by overly cautious detours, consistent with the simulation finding that distribution matching to d S d_{\mathrm{S}} biases the policy toward suboptimal safe routes. DexDICE (ours) reaches the goal in all ten trials along nearly indistinguishable trajectories that combine d P d_{\mathrm{P}} ’s directness with d S d_{\mathrm{S}} ’s wide obstacle margins, with zero boundary violations and tight intra-method variance.
paragraphs.zh: BC-Safe 是最安全的克隆基线，但其保守性使轨迹减速到约 40 秒，且有两个试验在到达目标前停滞。 FBC 达到专家速度，但其支持过滤器在硬件上过于宽松，导致擦碰障碍物和碰撞。 使用伪标签代价的 FISOR-IL 呈现出与 FBC 类似的“快但不安全”特征，只是违规更均匀地分布在整条轨迹上。 DemoDICE-U 在安全性和速度上都与 DexDICE 最接近；其两次失败都是由过于谨慎的绕行导致超时所致，这与仿真中关于对 d_S 的分布匹配会使策略偏向次优安全路径的发现一致。 DexDICE（我们的方法）在全部十次试验中均以几乎难以区分的轨迹到达目标，这些轨迹兼具 d_P 的直接性与 d_S 的宽障碍物裕度，实现零边界违规且方法内方差极小。

sents.en: FISOR-IL with pseudo-labeled cost shows a similar fast-but-unsafe profile to FBC, with violations spread more uniformly across the trajectory.
sents.zh: 使用伪标签代价的 FISOR-IL 呈现出与 FBC 类似的“快但不安全”特征，只是违规更均匀地分布在整条轨迹上。

sents.en: DexDICE (ours) reaches the goal in all ten trials along nearly indistinguishable trajectories that combine d P d_{\mathrm{P}} ’s directness with d S d_{\mathrm{S}} ’s wide obstacle margins, with zero boundary violations and tight intra-method variance.

paragraphs.en: Experiments were run on (i) two workstation nodes (NVIDIA RTX 5090 32 GiB, Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, 62 GiB RAM), (ii) four NVIDIA DGX Spark units, and (iii) Google Cloud n4 instances with Tesla T4 accelerators provisioned on demand for sweep parallelism. A single DexDICE training run on one re-curated DSRL task takes approximately 4 4 – 6 6 hours on an RTX 5090. Real-world experiments (Section 5.3 ) ran inference on the SUMMIT-XL on-board compute and trained offline on the workstation nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 实验在以下硬件上进行：(i) 两个工作站节点（NVIDIA RTX 5090 32 GiB、Intel Core Ultra 9 285K、62 GiB 内存），(ii) 四台 NVIDIA DGX Spark，以及 (iii) 配备 Tesla T4 加速器的 Google Cloud n4 实例，按需开通以用于扫参并行。 在 RTX 5090 上，对一个重新整理的 DSRL 任务进行单次 DexDICE 训练大约需要 4 4 – 6 6 小时。 真实世界实验（第 5.3 节）在 SUMMIT-XL 的机载计算设备上运行推理，并在工作站节点上进行离线训练。

paragraphs.en: This paper aims to advance safe offline imitation learning for safety-critical applications. While our framework is designed to ensure safety, it could in principle be misused to circumvent safety requirements. Deployment in domains such as autonomous driving or healthcare without rigorous validation may cause harm; responsible use lies with practitioners and deploying organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 本文旨在推进面向安全关键应用的安全的离线模仿学习。 虽然我们的框架旨在确保安全性，但它在原则上可能被滥用于规避安全要求。 在自动驾驶或医疗保健等领域未经严格验证就进行部署可能造成伤害；负责任的使用取决于从业者和部署组织。
